additional_info.subject: New Status Change
additional_info.body: The Status was changed from Repair Ongoing to Incident Solved Via Field Service (RC-L2) after 63 days, 16 hours, 25 minutes and 6 seconds.

Hi,
There is no Field Service Report for the FC2/3 fuse as we have rectified the fault during another operation. It is really only the fuse that has blown, although we cannot say whether it has blown itself (which does not seem to be the case) or whether it was switched off by someone after commissioning.  I think that someone unintentionally activated the fuse during the sealing work in the supply line area.
